text: Your Instagram Reel worked. Manychat sent the link. The lead replied... and then? <short pause> Nothing.

text: Then it replies the moment they finish typing. In your voice. Even at two a.m. You? You're asleep.
style: upbeat and confident, fast and playful, a quick knowing smile on the punchline

text: Lead gone quiet? It follows up. Even with a voice note, in your voice. <chuckle> Yes, really.
